releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 2.5.1 (FIXES FOR LAPTOPS AND LOST REBIRTHS)

Fixes for 2.5.0, which looked broken on a lot of laptops.

- The main menu fits small and zoomed-in screens again: nothing cut off or on top of each other.
- Sly's Black Market has two tabs, Pet Cases and Sly's Armory, so it fits on your screen.
- Big windows (inventory, the relic, pets) scroll instead of running off the screen.
- Starting the game on an island you'd sailed back to took away rebirths. Fixed, and the rebirths you lost come back.
- If something in the game breaks, it keeps running, tells you what broke, and sends the error to us so we can fix it.
